headline: QA-focused signals: mobile testing with local models, Playwright trace improvements, Copilot entering approval gates, Maestro mobile automation update, and Kubernetes APIserver memory reductions

top_signal.title: Android Studio Quail 4 stable: Gemma 4 and 23 curated Android Agent Skills arrive
top_signal.summary: Android Studio Quail 4 reached stable with built-in Gemma 4 (local model) and 23 curated Android Agent Skills, plus agent-mode tooling and peer-to-peer emulator multi-device testing to support agentic workflows and local AI assistance for app dev.
top_signal.why_it_matters: Local model + agent skills change how teams automate test generation, on-device verification, and agent-driven exploratory testing without sending code or APKs to external services.

items.title: Playwright release notes: new trace mode 'retain-on-first-failure' and test-generator updates
items.summary: Playwright's release notes add a trace mode 'retain-on-first-failure' and other test-runner improvements that reduce noise from retries and make failed-run diagnostics more actionable for triage and flaky-test investigation.
items.why_it_matters: Keeping traces for first failures reduces storage and noise while preserving the most useful evidence for root-cause and flaky-test debugging in CI pipelines.

items.title: Maestro v2.10.0 (mobile-dev-inc) — CLI and runtime update
items.summary: Maestro published v2.10.0 (including CLI 2.10.0), updating the mobile test orchestration toolchain used for cross-device synthetic tests and device-farm automation orchestration.
items.why_it_matters: Teams relying on Maestro for app UI automation should evaluate changelog items (CLI behavior, install scripts, dependency bumps) to avoid regressions in device-farm runs and test runners.

items.title: GitHub Copilot code review can now approve pull requests (public preview)
items.summary: Copilot code review now surfaces an approval assessment and — when enabled by admins — can submit approvals that count toward repository required-approvals rules (feature in public preview and off by default).
items.why_it_matters: Copilot as a merge gate changes QA review workflows and governance; teams must update policies, auditability, and required-approvals configuration before enabling automated approvals.

items.title: Selected GitHub Copilot models deprecated — update Copilot-based QA workflows
items.summary: GitHub announced deprecation (effective Sept 1, 2026) for several Copilot models (e.g., Gemini 3.1 Pro, older Claude variants) and recommended alternative models for Copilot experiences.
items.why_it_matters: If your test-generation, test-maintenance, or QA agents rely on specific Copilot models, update configurations and admin policies to avoid sudden behavior changes or missing model access in CI and IDE workflows.

items.title: Kubernetes v1.37: etcd RangeStream (beta) reduces API server memory on large list reads
items.summary: Kubernetes v1.37 promotes etcd RangeStream (beta) which streams large etcd reads in chunks (requires etcd v3.7), lowering memory spikes during watch-cache initialization and large list requests.
items.why_it_matters: Test clusters and platform teams can expect reduced OOM risk and more predictable memory during large e2e or scale tests; verify etcd version and feature-gate to use RangeStream.

learning.title: Emulator control for adaptive app development — programmatic fold/unfold and form-factor control
learning.summary: Android docs show terminal adb emu commands for programmatic emulator control (fold/unfold, form-factor changes, targeting by serial), enabling reproducible automated tests for foldables and adaptive UI.
learning.why_it_matters: Use these emulator commands to reliably exercise adaptive UI paths in CI and device labs, improving deterministic test coverage for foldables and multi-form-factor scenarios.
